rules.Key-Reuse: weakness.key_reuse.detected == Yes (keystream reuse is the primary recovery path; takes precedence over Static-IV)
rules.Memory-Key: candidate classification from required_artifacts mentioning memory/heap residue (observation of analysis condition); actual evidence is checked separately via required_conditions.no_reboot_heap_intact status, which decides Full vs Partial. NOT derived from recovery.method.class
rules.Static-IV: weakness.static_iv.detected == Yes AND NOT key_reuse (IV fixed without a direct key-reuse path)

method_class.note: When both static_iv and key_reuse are observed, Key-Reuse is the operative recovery path and takes precedence. Memory-Key is recorded from runtime/forensic observation.

prerequisites._note: prerequisites are read from structured required_conditions object {condition:{status:Confirmed|Not-Confirmed|Undetermined}}, NOT from free-text substring matching

bruteforce_feasibility.rule: keyspace in {Undetermined,Not-Analyzed,None} -> Undetermined; keyspace==0 -> No (recovery is via method, not keyspace brute-force; entropy value and brute-force applicability are separated); 0<keyspace<=40 -> Immediate; 40<keyspace<=64 -> Conditional; keyspace>64 -> No
bruteforce_feasibility.keyspace_zero: reserved value meaning 'no exhaustive-search target' (recovery via method path); not a 0-bit keyspace

assessment_class.rule: if method != None: Full if all prerequisites of that method are met, else Partial; elif bruteforce==Conditional: Keyspace-Reduced; else: Infeasible

definitions.Full: theoretical recoverability under stated prerequisites (NOT demonstrated decryption)
definitions.Infeasible: no known recovery path within observed scope (NOT proven mathematical impossibility)

known_plaintext_availability.cue_only: encryption.extent in {Partial,Intermittent,Header-Only} AND ext.included == Yes is a search cue only; never yields Yes by itself
known_plaintext_availability.semantics: candidate-present only (observation cue). NOT an input to assessment_class. For Key-Reuse/Static-IV, required_conditions.candidate_verifiable=Confirmed means a concrete verification oracle (plaintext-ciphertext pair or known fixed header) is identified in the record; actual acquisition of a pair for a given victim is an operational condition at response time, outside the judgment.

evaluation_order: rules evaluated in listed order, first matching clause applies; method priority Hardcoded-Key > Key-Reuse > Weak-RNG > Memory-Key > Static-IV > None
three_valued_logic: Kleene K3: True∨U=True; False∧U=False; ¬U=U; else U. Not-Analyzed ≺ Undetermined precedence (Eq. 4-5). method_class: max-priority confirmed indicator; if none confirmed and any indicator Undetermined -> Undetermined; assessment inherits Undetermined.
